fluff.overview: Xenoplanetary Condition Troops armed with laser rifles and vibro-blades for close combat, these XCT platoons carry sealed environmental gear that allows them to fight in toxic atmospheres, extreme temperatures, and hostile planetary conditions. The vibro-blades provide a close-quarters option when environmental hazards or confined spaces make ranged weapons impractical, though the platoon relies primarily on its laser rifles for standard engagements.
